Is it really free?
Yes. Playing is free and there is nothing to buy on the site. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need an account to play?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter. You open a game and play.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. The games run in your browser and start instantly, with no downloads or installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, many games are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category. Games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn the phone sideways, and a few older games need a keyboard and mouse and say so on their page.
Is it safe for my kids?
The site only allows family-friendly games: no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Yes, but only in your own browser. Recently played games, favourites, your light or dark choice and most games' own progress stay on your device, so clearing browser data or using private mode will lose them.
What do the cookie settings do?
If you are in Europe, you are asked before non-essential cookies are used. You can change your choice any time with "Cookie settings" in the footer.
A game will not load. What can I do?
Games come from different sources, so I cannot promise a fix for every case. If it keeps failing, email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and tell us which game it was.
Where do the games come from?

Six games are made by Door 404, the studio behind the site, and 26 were sent in directly by independent developers. The rest are licensed from the distribution networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix. Games are never copied from other portals.
How do I submit my own game?
Send it at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. It is free and non-exclusive, and a real person plays every submission. An accepted game gets its own page that credits you and links back to you.
How do I get my game removed?
Email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com. Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you can ask for it to be removed at any time.
Can I embed a game on my own website?
Only the site's own games, which have an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code on their page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence.
